08The stress test

On 18 November 2026, Dr. Walters tested the alarm against the profiler failures.

10of 11
periods of trouble
had a warning before them
first year  ·  chance gives 4.3
  • The rule was designed on the same year.
  • Since September 2026, there is only one period of trouble. There is no test on new data.
  • A warning does not show which roll or which part will fail.
  • For one third of the alarms, a change of one count in one day removes the alarm.
09Version 1.8: candidate, in review
  1. Rule 4Do not use values from a row that the feed cut short.
  2. Rule 5The normal range is never narrower than one count.
  3. Rule 6The 2 days must be on the same side of the normal range.
  4. Rule 7A day with no data is not a calm day. A warning closes after 30 production days at the latest.
Version 1.8 candidate 27 October 2026
10How to use the alarm today

A warning is a reason to examine the full profiler
at the next planned stop.

  1. DoExamine both sides of the profiler. Write down what you find.
  2. Do notDo not stop the line for a warning alone.
  3. Do notDo not read "no warning" as "the rolls are in good condition".
  4. Do notDo not use the alarm as a forecast of a failure.
11The next steps
  1. Step 1Release version 1.8 after the team examines it.
  2. Step 2Ask the controls technician what the roll value measures, and what changed on 27 May 2026.
  3. Step 3Write the test rules first. Then test the alarm on new data.
